title: Enhancing relationship strengths in immigrant and refugee families: Examining the feasibility and acceptability of the ANCHOR parenting program
abstract: Abstract Supportive parent–child relationships enable adolescents to navigate developmental transitions, respond to discrimination, strengthen ethnic‐racial identity, and maintain well‐being. Yet migration‐related stressors, including systemic barriers, economic insecurity, parent–child acculturation gaps, and shifts in family roles, can strain these relationships. This paper reports a single‐group pre‐post evaluation of ANCHOR (Advancing Newcomer Caregivers' Harmony, Openness, and Resilience), a strength‐based, community‐informed program designed to support immigrant and refugee caregivers of adolescents. Grounded in attachment‐based relational processes, ANCHOR aims to strengthen parents' ability to serve as a secure base and source of guidance throughout adolescence. Across 11 program deliveries involving 116 caregivers, 96 completed satisfaction surveys and provided qualitative feedback and 48 also completed pre‐ and post‐program assessments of parenting and relationship strengths. Among caregivers with pre‐post data, repeated measures analysis of covariance (ANCOVAs) indicated significant increases in parenting efficacy, parental empathy, and parent–child congruence. Reflexive thematic analysis identified perceived improvements in emotionally attuned communication, appreciation of children's perspectives, confidence in supporting adolescents' needs and navigating a new sociocultural context, and trust and connection within parent–adolescent relationships. Caregivers also emphasized the importance of a supportive group process that centered cultural strengths. These results suggest that ANCHOR is a feasible and acceptable intervention for immigrant and refugee caregivers (82.3% women) and provide preliminary evidence of improvements in parenting confidence, empathy, and parent–adolescent relationships. Further evaluation using more rigorous controlled designs is warranted.
